# Green Chili Indian Restaurant

> Authentic Indian restaurant in Dayton, OH — curries, tandoori, and biryani.

## Location & Contact
- Address: 1501 Lyons Road, Dayton, OH 45458, USA
- Phone: (937) 999-4545
- Website: https://green-chili-indian-restaurant-live.askkoraai.com

## Hours
- Sunday: 11:00 AM – 9:30 PM
- Monday–Thursday: 11:00 AM – 2:30 PM & 4:30 PM – 9:30 PM
- Friday–Saturday: 11:00 AM – 9:30 PM
